# Oxyderm Laser Clinic

> Premier medical laser and clinical skincare clinic in Edmonton, Alberta. Specializing in safe laser hair removal for all skin tones (Fitzpatrick I-VI) using Nd:YAG, Alexandrite, and IPL technology, plus microneedling, chemical peels, and skin rejuvenation.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2018
- Founder & Lead Medical Esthetician: Hetisha Shukla (Honours graduate, European Institute of Esthetics; 10+ years clinical experience)
- Location: Unit 211, 6958 76 Ave NW, Edmonton, AB T6B 2R2
- Contact: Phone: (780) 863-7561 | Email: info@oxydermlaserclinic.ca
- Hours: Monday - Saturday 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
- First Step: Free Consultation with a complimentary Test Patch before any laser treatment

## Core Services
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://oxydermlaserclinic.ca/laser-hair-removal-edmonton): Technology matched to skin tone using Nd:YAG, Alexandrite, and IPL.
- [Microneedling & Scar Therapy](https://oxydermlaserclinic.ca/microneedling-edmonton): Collagen induction therapy for acne scars and skin texture.
- [Skin Rejuvenation & Pigmentation](https://oxydermlaserclinic.ca/pigmentation-treatment-edmonton): Melanin-safe chemical peels, IPL photofacials, and dark spot care.
- [Microdermabrasion & Facials](https://oxydermlaserclinic.ca/facial-treatments): Deep clinical skin renewal.
